items.content: 大家好，我做了一个英文小工具网站： **Fullscreen Text** https://full-screen.app/ 它的功能很简单：输入一段文字，点击按钮后就可以立刻全屏显示，适合把手机、平板、电脑临时当作“文字展示牌”来用。 ### 这个工具适合什么场景 - 会议、教室、活动现场临时展示一句话 - 在嘈杂环境中快速给别人看一段文字 - 展示 “Starting Soon / Be Right Back / Welcome / Break” 这类提示语 - 没有必要专门做 PPT 或设计图时，快速把短文本放大展示 ### 目前特性 - 无需登录，打开即用 - 支持手机、平板、电脑 - 输入文字后可一键全屏 - 提供多种展示风格 - 支持自定义背景色和文字色 - 整体偏轻量，尽量减少复杂操作 ### 我为什么做这个 有时候只是想快速展示一句话，比如“稍等一下”“马上开始”“欢迎光临”，如果为了这件事去开 PPT、做图或者找别的软件，操作会有点重。 所以我做了这个尽量简单的版本：输入文字 -> 选择样式 -> 立即全屏。 ### 欢迎反馈 如果你觉得这个工具有用，或者你有更实际的使用场景、改进建议，也欢迎告诉我。 网站地址： https://full-screen.app/

items.title: fix(make_content): specify utf-8 encoding when reading/writing markdown
items.author: Bojun-Vvibe
items.summary: Repo: 521xueweihan/HelloGitHub (⭐ 152134) Type: bugfix Files changed: 1 Lines: +2/2 What script/makecontent/makecontent.py opens template/content markdown files with open(path, 'r') and writes the generated monthly issue with open(path, 'w'), relying on the platform default encoding. This change passes encoding='utf8' explicitly to both readfile and writefile. Why The HelloGitHub monthly content (content/HelloGitHubNN.md, template.md, etc.) is Chineselanguage Markdown encoded in UTF8. On any platform whose default locale.getpreferredencoding() is not UTF8 — most notably Windows where the default is cp1252/gbk — running python makecontent.py NN fails with UnicodeDecodeError, or worse, silently produces a mangled file when writing. Anyone trying to follow the README and regenerate an issue on Windows currently can't. Forcing UTF8 makes the script behave the same everywhere. Testing python c "import ast; ast.parse(open('script/makecontent/makecontent.py').read())" — parses cleanly. Manual review of the diff: only the two open() calls are touched; behavior on UTF8 systems is unchanged. A reproduction on Windows would set PYTHONIOENCODING=cp1252 and run the script against any content/HelloGitHubNN.md; before this patch it raises UnicodeDecodeError, after it succeeds. Risk Low — twoline change in helper functions, no behavior change on systems already defaulting to UTF8.
items.content:
**Repo:** 521xueweihan/HelloGitHub (⭐ 152134)
**Type:** bugfix
**Files changed:** 1
**Lines:** +2/-2

## What
`script/make_content/make_content.py` opens template/content markdown files with `open(path, 'r')` and writes the generated monthly issue with `open(path, 'w')`, relying on the platform default encoding. This change passes `encoding='utf-8'` explicitly to both `read_file` and `write_file`.

## Why
The HelloGitHub monthly content (`content/HelloGitHubNN.md`, `template.md`, etc.) is Chinese-language Markdown encoded in UTF-8. On any platform whose default `locale.getpreferredencoding()` is not UTF-8 — most notably Windows where the default is cp1252/gbk — running `python make_content.py NN` fails with `UnicodeDecodeError`, or worse, silently produces a mangled file when writing. Anyone trying to follow the README and regenerate an issue on Windows currently can't. Forcing UTF-8 makes the script behave the same everywhere.

## Testing
- `python -c "import ast; ast.parse(open('script/make_content/make_content.py').read())"` — parses cleanly.
- Manual review of the diff: only the two `open()` calls are touched; behavior on UTF-8 systems is unchanged.
- A reproduction on Windows would set `PYTHONIOENCODING=cp1252` and run the script against any `content/HelloGitHubNN.md`; before this patch it raises `UnicodeDecodeError`, after it succeeds.

## Risk
Low — two-line change in helper functions, no behavior change on systems already defaulting to UTF-8.

items.title: [开源推荐] RaTeX —— Rust 原生解析、排版 LaTeX 数学公式，支持 iOS、android、flutter、RN、Server-side PNG/SVG.
items.author: erweixin
items.summary: 项目地址 类别 Rust 项目标题 RaTeX使用Rust 原生解析、排版 LaTeX 数学公式 项目描述 在移动端渲染 LaTeX 数学公式，长期以来几乎只有三条路： 内嵌一个 WebView，跑 KaTeX 或 MathJax。代价是 50–150 MB 的隐藏内存开销，以及等 JavaScript 启动的延迟。 （360 纳米 AI 的做法） iOS Math 以及衍生的 swiftMath、AndroidMath，所支持的公式为 KaTeX 的有限子集，例如缺少 \ce 和 \pu 化学和物理公式的支持。\middle 语法不支持等。 （阿里千问的做法： 不支持 \ce、\pu 或者 \left( \frac{a}{b} \middle| \frac{c}{d} \right) 等常用的公式） 使用 KaTeX 做服务端渲染，移动端直接加载图片。 （腾讯元宝的做法） 要么接受低性能，要么接受少功能。 RaTeX 把 Web 栈整个去掉了。用纯 Rust 实现了一套 LaTeX 的解析与排版引擎， 产出一份「显示列表」——一组带坐标的绘图指令——然后交给各平台原生渲染： iOS 的 CoreGraphics、 Android 的 Canvas、 Flutter 的 Dart FFI、 React Native 的 Native 模块， 或者直接在服务端用 tinyskia 光栅化成 PNG。 实现各平台的高性能统一渲染。 项目覆盖约 99.5% 的 KaTeX 公式语法（内置对 \ce、\pu 的支持，仅有部分 \image 之类和 web 强绑定的语法不支持），各平台胶水层已就绪，可以直接集成。在线 Demo 可以实时对比 RaTeX 与 KaTeX 的渲染结果。 亮点 实现各平台的高性能统一渲染。 在移动端使用时，性能约是内嵌 web 端 katex 的 50倍，移动端内存占用少了 100150M。 相比移动端原生解决方案 iosMath、androidMath，内置 \ce、、\pu、\CD 等非常常用的物理化学公式。公式覆盖率更高。例如阿里千问不支持 left( \frac{a}{b} \middle| \frac{c}{d} \right) 语法。RaTeX 支持。 示例代码 markdown 截图或演示视频 架构

items.author: jiweiyuan
items.summary: 项目地址 类别 TypeScript 项目标题 SigCLI — AI Agent 的认证层，让 AI 安全访问外部系统 项目描述 AI Agent（Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot）需要访问 Jira、Slack、Wiki、内部 API 等工作系统，但凭证管理是安全难题——密钥会泄露到 shell 历史、环境变量和 AI 的上下文窗口。 SigCLI 在网络层解决这个问题：在 127.0.0.1 启动本地 MITM 代理（ECDSA P256 CA + 按域名动态签发叶证书），AI Agent 只需设置 HTTPPROXY，代理自动注入 Cookie / Authorization 等认证头——Agent 从头到尾不知道凭证的存在，凭证只存在于代理进程内存中。 AI Agent sig proxy (127.0.0.1) Target API | | | | GET /api/myself | | | (no auth headers) | + Cookie: SESSION=xxx | | | + Authorization: Bearer yyy| | | | | | | | < 200 OK | < 200 OK | bash npm install g @sigcli/cli sig init && sig login sig proxy start MITM 代理，AI Agent 设置 HTTPPROXY 即可 核心特性： 本地 MITM 代理 — 零信任凭证注入，凭证不进入 AI 进程内存 浏览器 SSO — 支持任何网站、任何登录流程，无头→可视自动切换 AES256GCM 加密存储 — 凭证不出现在代码仓库或 shell 历史中 4 种策略 — cookie、oauth2、apitoken、basic SSH 同步 — 笔记本登录，sig sync push 到远程机器 内置 Slack、Outlook、MS Teams 等 AI Agent Skills TypeScript & Python SDK MIT 开源。 网站：
items.content: ### 项目地址 https://github.com/sigcli/sigcli ### 类别 TypeScript ### 项目标题 SigCLI — AI Agent 的认证层，让 AI 安全访问外部系统 ### 项目描述 AI Agent（Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot）需要访问 Jira、Slack、Wiki、内部 API 等工作系统，但凭证管理是安全难题——密钥会泄露到 shell 历史、环境变量和 AI 的上下文窗口。 SigCLI 在网络层解决这个问题：在 `127.0.0.1` 启动本地 MITM 代理（ECDSA P-256 CA + 按域名动态签发叶证书），AI Agent 只需设置 `HTTP_PROXY`，代理自动注入 `Cookie` / `Authorization` 等认证头——Agent 从头到尾不知道凭证的存在，凭证只存在于代理进程内存中。 ``` AI Agent sig proxy (127.0.0.1) Target API | | | | GET /api/myself | | | (no auth headers) --> | + Cookie: SESSION=xxx | | | + Authorization: Bearer yyy| | | ------------------------> | | | | | <-- 200 OK -----------| <-- 200 OK -----------| ``` ```bash npm install -g @sigcli/cli sig init && sig login https://jira.example.com sig proxy start # MITM 代理，AI Agent 设置 HTTP_PROXY 即可 ``` 核心特性： - **本地 MITM 代理** — 零信任凭证注入，凭证不进入 AI 进程内存 - **浏览器 SSO** — 支持任何网站、任何登录流程，无头→可视自动切换 - **AES-256-GCM 加密存储** — 凭证不出现在代码仓库或 shell 历史中 - **4 种策略** — cookie、oauth2、api-token、basic - **SSH 同步** — 笔记本登录，`sig sync push` 到远程机器 - 内置 Slack、Outlook、MS Teams 等 AI Agent Skills - TypeScript & Python SDK MIT 开源。 网站：https://sigcli.ai

items.title: Coders.sh
items.summary: Everything Developers Bookmark in one place
items.content: Coders.sh offers personalized developer roadmaps based on your level (beginner, intermediate, advanced) and weekly time whether you have 5 hours or 20, it adapts to your schedule. Unlike static checklists based roadmaps, it focuses only on what you need. It also includes story-based SQL challenges, company & topic wise DSA questions, and 55+ developer tools and open-source utilities all in one place to reduce tab switching and help you build faster.

items.title: GeoFind
items.summary: The only platform for surveyors and geodetic firms in Serbia
items.content: GeoFind.rs is the first and only online platform in Serbia built exclusively for the geodesy profession. It connects licensed geodetic firms, surveyors, and clients in one place. Features include job listings, a service price calculator, and a geodetic equipment marketplace. Free for all geodetic professionals in Serbia.

items.title: PageOn.AI 3.0
items.summary: A smarter visual agent for slides, posters & infographics
items.content: A total visual leap. Smarter agent delivers stunning slides, posters and graphics instantly. No skills needed. Refine what you want, ship what impresses.

items.title: SoloOKRs
items.summary: An OKR management app built-in AI & MCP integration
items.content: SoloOKRs is designed for OPC (One Person Company) founders and individuals who want a focused, distraction-free environment to set, track, and reflect on their personal goals. A tool that helps align your goals with AI assistants so they can help you set objectives, track progress, complete key results, and conduct retrospectives. - szkane/SoloOKRs

items.title: weekraft - Gamified week planner
items.summary: Automate your weekly meals, groceries & tasks in seconds.
items.content: Stop wasting Sundays on planning. Weekraft generates a personalized 7-day schedule with meals, automated grocery lists, daily "sidequests," and music recommendations to beat decision fatigue and reclaim your weekends.

items.title: Vinted Turbo Scraper
items.summary: Fastest Vinted scraper: copy URL → CSV/JSON in seconds
items.content: ⚡ Scrape Vinted listings instantly from any filtered search URL. Copy your filtered Vinted URL, paste it in the Actor, and get clean structured data (title, price, images, seller, size, color, status...) in JSON, CSV or Excel. No more rebuilding filters manually. Perfect for resellers, dropshippers, market researchers & automation. Pay-per-result ($1.50 / 1,000 items) – no subscription. Built on Apify → schedule & integrate easily with Sheets, Make, n8n.

items.title: Spectrum
items.summary: Bring agents to all the interfaces people already use
items.content: Nobody is going to download an app or visit a website to use your agent. Spectrum is an open-source framework that connects your agents to iMessage, Telegram, WhatsApp, and other interfaces people use every day, using one unified API. Your agent sends one message, Spectrum handles the formatting, delivery, and platform-specific logic natively, in under 1 second. Spectrum is free to start. Scale to Pro or Enterprise when you're ready.

items.title: SHIFTLY
items.summary: AI-powered growth strategist for builders and small teams
items.content: AI growth strategist for startups and small teams. Get personalized user acquisition, product growth, and marketing playbooks powered by AI — actionable strategies to grow your product fast

items.title: NetDot
items.summary: Menu bar dot shows network speed, VPN protocol at a glance
items.content: NetDot is a tiny menu bar app for Mac that gives you instant network awareness without opening System Settings. A small dot shows your current link speed — Wi-Fi, Ethernet (1G, 10G), or VPN. Click it and you get your private IP, VPN protocol, MTU and connection type. Built for developers, sysadmins and power users who need to know what their network is doing at a glance. Minimalist. Always visible. No bloat.

items.title: Jordan Core
items.summary: AI-powered local search & smart tools for Jordan
items.content: JordanCore is an AI-powered local search and utility platform built for Jordan. It helps users quickly find trusted services, explore daily-life answers, and use smart tools like a window cost calculator tailored to real market prices. Unlike generic search engines, JordanCore focuses on local relevance — from services and businesses to practical tools that solve everyday problems. It combines AI-generated insights with structured data to deliver fast, useful, and context-aware results.

items.title: InclusiveSpeak
items.summary: Empowering Communication for Every Person and Child
items.content: A comprehensive Augmentative and Alternative Communication (AAC) platform designed to help children with speech difficulties express themselves, learn, and grow.

items.title: Joynote
items.summary: Spreading joy for everyone
items.content: Stop sending boring group cards or requiring to hit paywall or needing your work email to get started for simple, Joy boards. 🚀 Joynote is a no-signup kudos platform designed for modern teams or individuals. Share messages, GIFs, personalised images, doodles and songs in a sleek Instagram-style 'Story View.' Use AI to summarize, get past your writers block and spread the love and keep it forever as a PDF. Simple. Instant. Joyful.

items.title: Intelligent Test Plan Generator
items.summary: Stop writing test plans. Let AI do it for you.
items.content: Stop wasting hours on manual documentation. Intelligent Test Plan Generator automates your QA workflow by turning JIRA tickets into comprehensive test assets in seconds. Key Features: Instant Test Plans: Full coverage derived from requirements. BDD Scenarios: Gherkin-ready features for better collaboration. Code Generation: Ready-to-use Playwright & TypeScript step definitions. Traceability: Seamless mapping from ticket to test. Ship faster with 0 manual effort.

items.title: Rugby Unlocked
items.summary: Club to Player marketplace.
items.content: Rugby Unlocked connects ambitious rugby players with verified clubs worldwide. Find trials, recruitment opportunities, and your next rugby career move.

items.title: MF Forecast
items.summary: Real-time NAV estimates for mutual funds using AI
items.content: MF Forecast is a free AI-powered platform that provides real-time mutual fund NAV estimates updated every minute during Indian stock market hours. Track live performance, view sector heatmaps, stock attribution analysis, and verify prediction accuracy with our TruthLens transparency engine.

items.title: Sidepad - Capture and organize AI chats
items.summary: Your companion for AI conversations.
items.content: Your companion for AI conversations. Capture responses from ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI tools into structured Markdown documents, saved locally, never uploaded.

items.title: Talkory.ai
items.summary: Turn many AI answers into one verified answer
items.content: One prompt, multiple top AI models, one clearer answer. Talkory.ai lets you compare GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, and Perplexity side by side, then turns their responses into a Consensus Answer and Common Answer you can trust. Improve every output with Recursive Correction, export complete reports to PDF, and share results instantly with a secure link for faster research, better decisions, and more confident AI-powered workflows.

items.title: Sierra - AI tutor speaker
items.summary: Speak like a native in your next interview
items.content: You already know the language. Now say it out loud: the interview, the dinner, the client call. Sierra listens, corrects your pronunciation, and hands back the phrase a fluent speaker would've used. In 97 languages, on any topic.

items.title: docmd
items.summary: Build production-ready site from Markdown in seconds.
items.content: docmd is an open-source documentation engine that generates production-grade sites from Markdown with zero configuration. No heavy frameworks or complex setups. Just run `npx @docmd/core dev` in any folder with Markdown files to get an instant, SEO-optimized, lightweight SPA (< 20kb JS). It’s the only self-hosted solution that’s fully extensible and AI-native with built-in `llms.txt` generation, internationalization (i18n), and offline search.

items.title: PESCO Online Bill
items.summary: Check and download PESCO bills instantly in Pakistan
items.content: PESCO Online Bill Checker helps users in Pakistan check and download their latest electricity bills instantly. Simply enter your 14-digit reference number or 10-digit consumer ID to view duplicate bills without login. It also provides helpful information like bill details, tariff understanding, and electricity usage guidance in a simple and fast interface.
